reason: The pilot costing nothing is fair, but at the end of the day it's another 465 to 618 euros a month, and that's only worth it if we actually cancel what we have now. I'm not putting a two-person startup in front of the board until I've seen Zwolle running and spoken to their treasurer.
objection: Two founders with no track record. If they get it wrong, I'm the one explaining to 950 members why their invoices or tee times went haywire. And I don't believe an app will fix us losing members.
would_change_my_mind: Zwolle's board telling me on the phone that it works, plus a cost comparison showing that once we cancel our current system the total doesn't go up.
